title: Clean-Worktree and CI Lean 4 Reproduction Gate
statement: O6 — the clean-worktree record VERIFICATION_RUN_007 reports 17/17 PASS at commit 07185a6, which was the full target inventory at that time. The current repository gate declares 30 targets and was rerun 2026-09-04 at 30/30 PASS, exit 0, under Lean v4.33.0-rc1 and Mathlib 5eec30bc, using a Mathlib checkout already present in .lake/packages. Cold-runner reproduction and a CI release gate remain open.

verification.target_count: 30/30 PASS (current warm-cache gate, 2026-09-04); 17/17 PASS (clean-worktree RUN_007 at 07185a6)
verification.quarantine_reason: Current local verification is fresh and passing, but the clean-worktree walk covered 17 targets, not the present 30, and neither cold-runner reproducibility nor a CI release gate has been demonstrated.

epistemic_boundary.closure_path: Demonstrate on a cold runner with empty ~/.cache/mathlib, pin lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json, and archive clean cold-runner execution logs.
